passage.text: Here are three great stalls for your next food trip.
passage.reading: ˈhɪr ər ˈθriː ˈɡreɪt ˈstɔːlz fər jʊr ˈnɛkst ˈfuːd ˈtrɪp.

passage.text: The first stall is near Chinatown, and it sells crispy pork with rice.
passage.reading: ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈstɔːl ɪz ˈnɪr ˈtʃaɪnətaʊn, ənd ɪt ˈsɛlz ˈkrɪspi ˈpɔːrk wɪð ˈraɪs.

passage.text: The pork is perfect, and the sauce is sweet and a little spicy.
passage.reading: ðə ˈpɔːrk ɪz ˈpɜːrfɪkt, ənd ðə ˈsɔːs ɪz ˈswiːt ənd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈspaɪsi.

passage.text: The second stall is on a small street behind the train station.
passage.reading: ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈstɔːl ɪz ɑːn ə ˈsmɔːl ˈstriːt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈtreɪn ˈsteɪʃən.

passage.text: An old woman has sold pad Thai there for forty years.
passage.reading: ən ˈoʊld ˈwʊmən hæz ˈsoʊld ˈpɑːd ˈtaɪ ˈðɛr fər ˈfɔːrti ˈjɪrz.

passage.text: Her pad Thai has a sweet and sour flavor, and everyone loves it.
passage.reading: hɜːr ˈpɑːd ˈtaɪ ˈhæz ə ˈswiːt ənd ˈsaʊər ˈfleɪvər, ənd ˈɛvriwʌn ˈlʌvz ɪt.

passage.text: The third stall sells coconut ice cream, and it's perfect on a hot day.
passage.reading: ðə ˈθɜːrd ˈstɔːl ˈsɛlz ˈkoʊkənʌt ˈaɪs ˈkriːm, ənd ɪts ˈpɜːrfɪkt ɑːn ə ˈhɑːt ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: All three stalls are cheap, and the food is authentic.
passage.reading: ˈɔːl ˈθriː ˈstɔːlz ər ˈtʃiːp, ənd ðə ˈfuːd ɪz ɔːˈθɛntɪk.

passage.text: Most dishes cost about fifty baht.
passage.reading: ˈmoʊst ˈdɪʃɪz ˈkɔːst əˈbaʊt ˈfɪfti ˈbɑːt.

passage.text: Go early, because there are long lines in the evening!
passage.reading: ˈɡoʊ ˈɜːrli, bɪˈkɔːz ðɛr ər ˈlɔːŋ ˈlaɪnz ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ!
